title: Get help and support
goal: Know what information to prepare and which confirmed first step to take when this guide does not resolve a Pro-finder problem.

warnings.text: The manufacturer contact details printed in the source have not been confirmed as current and are therefore not published in this English draft. Do not copy a telephone number, email address or website from an older manual without verification.

steps.text: For installation or operating questions, contact the specialist dealer first.

If the issue remains, use only a current manufacturer support route that has been confirmed as current. The exact website, telephone number and email address remain withheld here until that confirmation is available.

sources.note: The historical details are intentionally omitted under BLK-004.

steps.text: Prepare the serial number and software version of the Pro-finder. The source says that both can be found on the device or in the THITRONIK App, but it does not provide a precise location or reading rule.

sources.region: Section 6.4, information required for a support call

expected_result: You have contacted the confirmed first point of assistance and prepared the device information needed for a focused response, without relying on an unverified support route.

error_cases.problem: The serial number cannot be located on the device.
error_cases.correction: The source names only the device or the THITRONIK App and gives no exact position or reading rule. Do not infer which number fragment determines the generation; ask the specialist dealer or a confirmed support route.

sources.region: Section 6.4, serial number and software version
